description: The nth Tetranacci number. T0, T1, and T2 are 0, T3 is 1, and each later term is the sum of the previous four. T(10) is 56. An optional modulus reduces the term, and zero is rejected. n runs from 0 to 4096. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/tetranacci
